==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Brighter&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/BrighterTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Brighter&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using VerifyTests.Brighter;

// Verify.Brighter: A recording command processor for Brighter, so what a handler sent, published or deposited can be verified.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Brighter
// Note: Post and PostAsync are recorded under the Publish key, so the samples stay with Send until
// that is fixed.
// Note: Call always returns null: the recording processor records the call rather than answering
// it.
// Note: VerifyBrighter.Initialize() only adds converters, so it is safe to call after a
// verification has already run.
public class BrighterTests
{
    // The recording processor is a test double rather than an ambient recording: it is handed to
    // the code under test, and verifying it covers every request that code sent or published.
    [Fact]
    public async Task Handler()
    {
        var processor = new RecordingCommandProcessor();
        var handler = new BrighterHandler(processor);

        await handler.Handle(new("the value"));

        await Verify(processor);
    }

    // Sends, Publishes, Deposits and Calls each expose one kind of call, for a test that is only
    // about one of them, or that wants to filter before verifying.
    [Fact]
    public async Task Sends()
    {
        var processor = new RecordingCommandProcessor();
        var handler = new BrighterHandler(processor);

        await handler.Handle(new("the value"));

        await Verify(processor.Sends);
    }
}
